Name: RSM Ground to Image Grid Identification (RSMGI)
Description: The Replacement Sensor Model Ground to image Grid Identification TRE (RSMGI) associates a ground-to-image grid with an image. The (interpolated)ground-to-image grid makes up the RSM ground-to-image function. The RSMGI TRE provides general information regarding the ground-to-image grid geometric image to ground relationship. In particular, it identifies which image section is applicable to an arbitrary ground point. The RSM image domain may consist of a single section or it may be divided into at most 256 sections. Each section has its own unique ground-to-image grid, defined in its own RSM Ground-to-image Grid TRE (RSMGG). Most images require only one section. Note that the RSMGI TRE is completely analogous to the RSMPI TRE that is used when a (rational) polynomial makes up the RSM ground to image function. If both TREs are present for the associated image, the output of the RSM ground to image grid is defined as an image space correction to the output of the RSM (rational) polynomial. Because the RSMGI TRE is optional when there is only one image section, the actual condition is that at least one RSMGG TRE and at least one RSMPC TRE are present.) However, the image sections defined in the RSMGI TRE are completely independent of the image sections defined in the RSMPI TRE.

IID.Name: Image Identifier
IID.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the original full image that corresponds to the associated image. This is not to be confused with the identification of an image derived by filtering, chipping, re-sampling, or other such image-to-image transformations. The image identifier is left justified with trailing spaces.

EDITION.Name: RSM Image Support Data Edition
EDITION.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the RSM support data for the associated original full image. It is to consist of an identifier of up to 20 characters for the processor that generated the RSM support data, to which is appended up to 20 characters that are unique among RSM TRE sets that are generated by that processor.

GR0.Name: Low Order Polynomial Constant Coefficient for Row
GR0.Description: This field provides the constant term used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

GRX.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of X for Row
GRX.Description: This field provides the coefficient of x used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

GRY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of Y for Row
GRY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of y used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

GRZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of Z for Row
GRZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of z used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

GRXX.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XX for Row
GRXX.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xx used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

GRXY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XY for Row
GRXY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xy used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

GRXZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XZ for Row
GRXZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xz used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

GRYY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of YY for Row
GRYY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of yy used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

GRYZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of YZ for Row
GRYZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of yz used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

GRZZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of ZZ for Row
GRZZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of zz used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

GC0.Name: Low Order Polynomial Constant Coefficient for Column
GC0.Description: This field provides the constant term used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

GCX.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of X for Column
GCX.Description: This field provides the coefficient of x used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

GCY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of Y for Column
GCY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of y used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

GCZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of Z for Column
GCZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of z used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

GCXX.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XX for Column
GCXX.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xx used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

GCXY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XY for Column
GCXY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xy used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

GCXZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XZ for Column
GCXZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xz used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

GCYY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of YY for Column
GCYY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of yy used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

GCYZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of YZ for Column
GCYZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of yz used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

GCZZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of ZZ for Column
GCZZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of zz used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

GRNIS.Name: Row Number of Image Sections
GRNIS.Description: This field identifies the number of sections the RSM image domain is divided into along the row direction for representation of the ground to image relationship.

GCNIS.Name: Column Number of Image Sections
GCNIS.Description: This field identifies the number of sections the RSM image domain is divided into along the row direction for representation of the ground to image relationship.

GTNIS.Name: Total Number of Image Sections
GTNIS.Description: This field contains the total number of rectangular sections the RSM image domain is divided into for representation of the ground-to-image relationship. The value in this field is the product of the values in the GRNIS and GCNIS fields. Thus, the value of the field GTNIS, with a maximum of 256, places constraints on the values of the fields GRNIS and GCNIS. This number represents the total number of RSMGG TREs.

GRSSIZ.Name: Section Size in Rows
GRSSIZ.Description: This field contains the number of rows contained in a single section. Note that its value is represented as a positive non-integer because it equals the number of rows in the RSM image domain divided by the number of sections in the row direction, not necessarily an integer value.

GCSSIZ.Name: Section Size in Columns
GCSSIZ.Description: This field contains the number of columns contained in a single section. Note that its value is represented as a positive non-integer because it equals the number of columns in the RSM image domain divided by the number of sections in the column direction, not necessarily and integer value.
